Alpine package libxslt 1.1.43-r3 in the upstream postgres:18-alpine image (index built 2026-11-05), loaded only by the contrib extension xml2, which the application never installs. In the stacks with deploy/postgres-init (production, staging, demo, dev) the app and admin roles are NOSUPERUSER and cannot create it; in the local development compose the app role is the bootstrap superuser.
